comparison.scope: Matched one-seed nominal-layout comparison; geometry-informed action support changes the proposal distribution. Include geometry precompute cost. No new-layout/noise robustness or physical validation claim.

home_comparison.scope: Canonical simulator episode reset before visible drives. Measured home state repeatability and target consistency are reported separately; retained path flags describe reset eligibility, not a physical home trajectory. No score rows are removed and no physical calibration/collision certificate is implied.

mean_action_change.scope: Direct deterministic network outputs before IK; changes alone do not prove a capture-rate improvement

scope: One-seed geometry-assisted local continuous shot-selection study at inherited coordinates. Raw RGB, full native telemetry, probe histories, runtime configurations and logs excluded. Retained measurement-error summaries are native simulation evidence, not physical calibration. No policy promotion or globally unseen-layout success claim.

settings_export.scope: Requested configurations, per-site nominal outcomes, provenance and derived pose errors. Direct native board/joint/retention/contact readbacks are excluded from Git; full CSV stays in the local interface.

supported_mean_action_change.scope: Only the33 supported contexts; excludes2 withheld global-bound fallback requests. Actual arm transit remains scripted.
